message: The per-module setup routes (.claude/skills/engine-setup-<module-id>/SKILL.md) are derived-committed artifacts: they are generated from the offerable module manifests' presentation records and must never be hand-authored. This check regenerates them from those manifests and compares; if a committed route was hand-edited, left stale after a presentation change, or is missing, it goes red. To fix it, regenerate with `uv run --directory .engine -- python tools/setup_route_gen.py generate` and commit the result.
